approved_by: project owner, Gate A review 2026-10-13 (CONDITIONAL APPROVAL): C1+C2 priority, C3a/C3b with safety guards, C4-C7 exploratory, K_V2_CAND_ML approved, one-shot Validation and Confirm-C after freeze, Test-H and Holdout stay locked
amendment_rule: A frozen spec is never edited in place. A change is a new spec_version with an owner-approved reason; the guard hash in cand_v2_spec.sha256 is replaced in the same commit. No amendment may follow a look at Validation, Confirm-C, Test-H or Holdout outcomes.

control.rule: Immutable. The control is core/decision.py:decide with DecisionConfig() defaults, pinned by tests/unit/test_strategy_lock.py. The candidate never edits it; the candidate calls it.

candidate.construction: A thin layer around the control's decide(): the chain labels, stop, targets, net R:R and sizing are the control's code, unchanged. With every flag off the candidate is identical to the control (parity test). Differences are limited to: setup memory (C1), the cost gate (C2), the volatility gates (C3a, C3b) and the guards named below.
candidate.honest_scope: CAND-CORE changes lifecycle and gating, not the labels that generate direction, setup or trigger (C4, C5, C6 are exploratory and NOT implemented in this freeze). It is therefore not claimed to be a new brain; whether it is one is a finding, not an assumption.

invariants.daily_loss_governor: core.paper.GovernorConfig defaults (stop 2.0%, flatten 3.5%, 1 open position, 2/hour, 3/session, 6/day, cooldowns), unchanged
invariants.authority: Human is the final decision authority; the strategy and the ML shadow only advise

definitions.price_space: All levels live in the broker's BID chart (MT5 bars are bid). BUY enters at the ask (bid + spread), SELL at the bid. BUY exits at the bid, SELL exits at the ask (bar high/low + the bar's spread).

cost_accounting.planning_gate_net_rr: net_rr = (reward - spread) / (risk + spread) is the control's planning gate. It is KEPT unchanged (MIN_NET_RR is invariant) and is NOT a charge.
cost_accounting.outcome_charges: Outcomes are realised by the PAPER fill rules only: entry quote plus 3 points adverse slippage, stops fill with 3 points adverse slippage, targets fill exactly at their level, SELL exits and BUY entries pay the spread through the ask/bid mechanics, swap ASSUMED per core.costs. NOTHING further is deducted from outcomes, so spread and slippage are charged exactly once.
cost_accounting.cost_gate_C2: cost_R = (spread_price + 2 * slippage_price) / risk_dist, spread_price from the EXECUTABLE quote (ask - bid) when the context has one, else from the state; a SCREEN, not a deduction
cost_accounting.why_not_double_counting: net_rr (planning), cost_R (screen) and the realised PnL (accounting) answer three different questions. Only the realised PnL is summed into the endpoint; the realised decomposition (gross price move, realised spread, realised slippage, swap) is reported per trade so any residual double count is visible.
cost_accounting.known_conservatism: For BUY the control's net_rr deducts the spread although the entry is already at the ask; this makes the planning gate conservative for BUY. It is documented, not corrected (the invariant stands).

definitions.episode: A maximal run of emitted signal bars of the same side whose consecutive gaps are <= 60 minutes.
definitions.episode_to_trade: One trade is attempted per episode, at its FIRST signal bar, subject to the V1 governor and to no open position. A refused episode is lost; later bars of the same episode never open a trade. The same rule applies to every variant including the control.
definitions.execution_timing: Signals are evaluated at each closed M5 bar. The executable quote is the last closed M1 bar of that minute: bid = its close, ask = close + that bar's spread. The position is managed on closed M1 bars that open at or after the fill minute (V1 paper rule). A missing M1 bar means no signal for that bar.
definitions.management: Stop first when a bar reaches both levels (pessimistic). No time stop; the simulation horizon is 10 calendar days after entry, then the position is closed at the market quote and flagged HORIZON.
definitions.shock: Reuse the existing constant SHOCK_RANGE_ATR = 3.0 (core/structure.py): a closed bar whose range >= 3.0 x the previous bar's ATR(14). SHOCK is true when ANY of: the last 2 closed M15 bars include one; the last closed H1 bar is one; the H4 regime is SHOCK; the M1 micro state is ABNORMAL. No new numeric constant is introduced.
definitions.spike_guard: spread_percentile >= 0.99 (percentile within the last 300 M5 spreads) blocks. 0.99 only removes true spikes; the control's 0.90 removes 10% of time by construction.

lifecycle.armed_condition: the control's setup condition at the closed M5 bar: H1 bias = side AND H4 does not veto AND M15 structure = with-trend AND M15 pullback = the matching pullback label
lifecycle.memory_rule: While the armed condition is true the memory is refreshed. When it turns false the setup stays ARMED for at most 6 further closed M5 bars. A trigger inside the window is evaluated with the setup labels substituted by their armed values; every other input is the current bar's.
lifecycle.planned_invalidation_level: stop price computed by compute_stop at the bar the setup armed (BUY below, SELL above)
invalidated_when_any: H1 bias changes from the side (flip or neutral) at any M5 close
an M5 close beyond the planned invalidation level
M15 structure turns against the side (UP/DOWN opposite, or REVERSAL opposite)
data stale, market closed, or feed missing
lifecycle.one_candidate_per_setup: enforced by the episode rule above
lifecycle.planned_stop_rule: FIXED at the bar where the setup formed; never refreshed
lifecycle.replay: One continuous replay of the run window. Month boundaries reset nothing.
lifecycle.checkpoint: after each month: spec sha, code version, clean-store manifest sha, variants, bar index, last bar, bar-history hash chain, memories, self hash; atomic write, previous one kept
lifecycle.restart: restore only if every field and the bar history match; else COLD: C1 decisions are WAIT (RESTORE_PENDING) until the armed condition has been off for memory_bars + 1 bars

simulation_notes.equity: R-based and non-compounding: nominal equity 10000, 0.25% = 25 USD per R; sizing rounding and the minimum-lot refusal are not modelled (negligible at this equity).
simulation_notes.governor: core.paper.governor_check with GovernorConfig defaults. The day is the UTC date; the day's loss uses closed trades of that day; flatten at 3.5% is unreachable (it would need at least 14 R lost in a day with at most 6 trades) and is not simulated.
simulation_notes.stop_gaps: The desk's rule fills a stop at the stop level (plus 3 points). A bar that OPENS beyond the stop is flagged 'gap_through_stop' and counted as a safety finding; the fill is not changed.
simulation_notes.signals_sizing: Stage A runs with equity None (no sizing); lots are not needed for R.
simulation_notes.warmup: Indicators use history from before the window start (including, for Confirm-C, the last weeks of the locked Test-H window as PRICE CONTEXT only; no signal and no outcome of a locked window is ever produced).
simulation_notes.data: M1 bars from the shared store; a missing M1 bar at the decision minute means no signal and resets every lifecycle memory.

C1.name: stateful lifecycle
C1.hypothesis: setup and trigger are sequential events; requiring the same bar discards valid setups
C1.outcome_test: incremental trades of A_C1 over CTRL

C2.name: cost-per-risk gate
C2.replaces: SPREAD_TOO_WIDE from execution_quality POOR (spread percentile >= 0.9 or spread/ATR5 > 0.15); an UNKNOWN spread still refuses; M1 ABNORMAL still blocks through the control's M1 chain
C2.hypothesis: cost must be measured against the trade's risk, not against 5-minute noise

C3a.name: drop the LOW volatility percentile gate
C3a.hypothesis: with C2 the economic cost of thin markets is priced directly; the rank-based gate blocks ~20% of time by construction

C3b.name: HIGH volatility percentile gate and H4 HIGH_VOLATILITY block replaced by SHOCK guard
C3b.hypothesis: trend continuation lives in expanding volatility; the ATR is already in the stop size

C7.name: opposing structure from higher timeframes
C7.hypothesis: minor M15 swings are noise obstacles for pullback continuation; MIN_NET_RR stays 1.5
C7.status: Dev-only research; cannot enter the frozen candidate

C6.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED in this freeze (G10 advice stays advisory)

windows.no_retuning_rule: Validation and Confirm-C never change a parameter, a variant list or a selection. A failed confirmation is reported as failed.

statistics.primary_endpoint: E = mean realised net R per executed PAPER trade (all PAPER charges, swap included). R = realised PnL / |entry quote - planned stop| (the quote before slippage). Months for the bootstrap are the calendar month of the trade's CLOSE.
secondary_endpoints: false-positive rate = share of trades stopped out within 6 M5 bars
statistics.uncertainty: one-sided 97.5% bound of E by a calendar-month block bootstrap (B = 10000, seed 7); the same for incremental trades.

N_min.rule: Below either, every outcome inference is INCONCLUSIVE whatever the point estimate.

power.formula: n = DEFF * ((z_alpha + z_beta) * sd / delta)^2 for a one-sample mean against a margin delta (z_alpha = 1.96, z_beta = 0.8416)
power.supersedes: the Gate A report figure (about 250 per arm at sd 1.2, 385 at sd 1.5), which omitted the power term and the design effect (about 50% power); Monte Carlo confirms 0.80 power at the table sizes

statuses.REFUTED_HARM: N >= N_min and the one-sided 97.5% UPPER bound of E < 0
statuses.SUPPORTED: N >= N_req(delta = 0.20R) and the 97.5% LOWER bound of E > 0

statistics.control_comparison: The control has too few trades for a difference test. Candidate-versus-control is reported (a) as incremental trades (trades present in the variant and absent in its parent) with the statuses above, and (b) as a paired monthly-block difference only when BOTH arms have N >= N_min, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Safety caps are absolute (below), never relative to the control.

absolute_caps.rationale: 20R = 5% of equity and 8R = 2% of equity at 0.25% per R, the scale of the daily loss stop

violations_counted_as_failures: a signal with net_rr < 1.5, stop > 3 ATR, risk != 0.25%, or an uncapped target != 2R
a signal during SHOCK or the spike guard
a trade opened against the governor
a realised loss worse than 1R plus 3 points of slippage plus a bar gap beyond the stop (counted and listed, not hidden)

selection_rule.primary: A CORE change Ci enters the frozen candidate iff (S) structural: reachability (episodes per year) is not lower than its parent variant, AND (V) zero safety violations, AND (O) the outcome status of its incremental trades and of the whole variant is not REFUTED_HARM, AND the absolute safety caps hold on DEV.
selection_rule.inconclusive_policy: INCONCLUSIVE is allowed to enter for C1 and C2 (owner priority). For C3a and C3b INCONCLUSIVE enters only as 'research, flagged'. No change is ever included because its point estimate looks good.
selection_rule.tie_break: fewest changes; then the variant with the lower episode frequency.
never: automatic union of all seven changes
use of Validation, Confirm-C, Test-H or Holdout to choose
selection_rule.frozen_candidate_is: the CORE-tier variant selected by this rule on DEV, written to docs/research/cand_v2_frozen.json with the code git sha, before any confirmation run.
selection_rule.closed_list_fallback: The frozen candidate must be a variant of the closed list. Let I be the set of CORE changes that pass the rule. If a listed variant has exactly the change set I, it is the candidate. Otherwise it is the listed CORE-tier variant with the largest change set contained in I (ties: lower episode frequency). If I is empty the candidate is CTRL, i.e. NO candidate is frozen and the report says so.
selection_rule.structural_test: S holds for Ci when episodes(A_Ci) >= episodes(CTRL) AND episodes(CORE) >= episodes(LOO_noCi) on DEV.
selection_rule.outcome_test: O holds for Ci when the status of the incremental trades of A_Ci over CTRL, the status of the incremental trades of CORE over LOO_noCi, and the status of E of the variant that contains Ci (CORE) are none of them REFUTED_HARM.
selection_rule.caps_test: The absolute safety caps hold for every variant that contains Ci.
selection_rule.safety_verification: V is verified on every emitted signal: net_rr >= 1.5, stop distance <= 3 ATR, risk 0.25%, C2 variants cost_R <= 0.15 and spread percentile < 0.99, C3b variants never on a SHOCK bar (bars table), plus the property tests.
